title: [GOV-LEASE-6H] Thu hồi lease sau 6 giờ không tiến triển
body:
# Governance Packet draft — lease no-progress 6 giờ

Authority: [owner comment trên #748](https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/issues/748#issuecomment-6253065468). Đây là Packet governance riêng; chưa cấp lease Executor, chưa đổi protocol và chưa tác động lease WP748 g19.

## Objective

Đổi ngưỡng thu hồi lease vì **không có tiến triển** tại `docs/PROTOCOL_DA_PHIEN.md` §3.6 từ 30 phút thành 6 giờ (360 phút) cho các lease mới sau khi thay đổi land. Giữ nguyên hạn tuyệt đối `lease_until`, fencing generation, tombstone hai phía, exact-head invalidation, reviewer SLA và thời hạn heartbeat 15 phút sau `changes_requested`. Không sửa lịch sử lease đã phát.

## Candidate Packet schema (chưa ready)

```yaml
schema_version: 1
packet_id: wp<issue-number>
mission_issue: <issue-number>
revision: 1
spec_hash: <Git-byte SHA256 sau khi publish spec>
objective: lease no-progress 360 minutes for future leases
write_set:
  - {type: exact, path: docs/PROTOCOL_DA_PHIEN.md}
  - {type: exact, path: docs/adr/0055-lease-no-progress-six-hours.md}
depends_on: []
executor: claude
environment: local
risk: sensitive
review_class: sensitive
acceptance_criteria:
  - Protocol §3.6 uses 360 minutes for no-progress and ambiguous review_sla fallback.
  - Existing absolute expiry and 15-minute post-verdict heartbeat remain unchanged.
  - New ADR supersedes only the 30-minute statement in ADR-0017; §20 table and adr-song gate pass.
  - No active in-repo controller enforces a conflicting 30-minute rule, or implementation and tests are added by an authorized revision.
  - Future lease examples use heartbeat_required_minutes 360; existing lease YAML files remain byte-identical.
  - Independent read-only review and exact-head required gates pass before any product push or merge.
```

Proposed immutable acceptance base: remote `master` `577d7b95d257f6c376677e1ffb0131d12b74d24e` measured 2026-10-19 Asia/Saigon; remeasure before lease. Executor Claude Code Opus 5.5 Windows; Reviewer independent Codex exact-head read-only. The local canonical checkout is dirty with unrelated work, so use a separate clone.

## Preflight blocker to resolve before lease

`docs/PROTOCOL_DA_PHIEN.md` §5 names `.github/coordination/change-impact.v1.json` as the canonical closure policy, but that path is absent from `master` at the proposed base. The new Packet must document how effective write set and required checks are derived under the current rollout, or obtain a revision/authority to add the missing control. Do not grant an Executor lease while this is unresolved. No active in-repo Python enforcement of `heartbeat_required_minutes` was found in the targeted scan; external controllers remain to be verified.

## Limits

This issue does not grant a lease or land authority. WP748 g19 retains its published 30-minute inactivity rule. Applying 6 hours to WP748 requires a later authorized successor lease. No merge, land, LIVE or real credentials are requested here.
